name: Direct2App

sources.title: Homepage — live SaaS & AI tools directory with categories/tags, featured and latest listings
Pricing — Free $0 (dofollow but requires reciprocal backlink, ~30-day review), Pro $7.99, Premium $29.99
Submit URL — redirects to a login/register wall (email, Google, or GitHub auth)

conditions: Free plan requires a backlink to direct2app.com from your site (badge/link verification offered on the pricing page)
Free listings sit in a queue — 'reviewed and listed within 30 days'
Account registration required (email, Google, or GitHub)
requirements: SaaS/AI/software product — directory categories span AI, SaaS, dev tools, SEO, marketing, fintech, hosting, etc.
Free: reciprocal backlink + up to 30-day wait, no support; Pro $7.99 removes the backlink and publishes immediately; Premium $29.99 adds featured placement + badge
All tiers claim a permanent/lifetime listing
preparation: Product name, URL, description, icon/logo, category and tag selections
For free plan: add their backlink/badge to your site before submitting so verification passes
workflow: Register or sign in at https://direct2app.com/submit
Fill product details, categories, and tags
Free: wait up to ~30 days for review; Pro/Premium: publishes immediately
Verify the listing appears under /search and its category page
watchFor: Free tier's 'dofollow' benefit is contingent on keeping the reciprocal backlink live
30-day review lag on the free plan — not usable for a timed launch
Direct 'Visit Website' outbound button is Premium-only; lower tiers link through the item detail page
Watch for the Domain Rating badge/verify widget requirement — an unverified backlink may stall the listing
countsAsLive: The product has a public /item/<slug> page on direct2app.com, searchable and linked from category/tag pages
unknowns: Exact form fields behind the auth wall
Whether the free plan's backlink is re-checked periodically
